context:
Goal: retiring banchi's docs/map.py loses nothing (your item 209 a).
Problem (rule): 8 non-code files (icons, the web manifest, an onnx model, the STE licence) carried 19 decision ids in the old map. The shared map maps code files only, so an edit to one of them now shows no decision hint. banchi #1064 restores the other 72 ids, on the json files.
Based on (ruling): 209 a, "no loss"; rule building-port-keeps-behaviour. Asked again because your note asked whether banchi's map had a feature the shared map lacks.
Based on (read): yes, two. First, decision lookup (`make map ARGS=D17` listed the files that cite a decision). Roadmap step map-show-decision-lookup adds it to the shared map now. Second, decision hints on non-code files: this item. No other gap is on record; no session listed every feature of banchi's docs/map.py side by side with the shared map.
Departs from: banchi main before #1063 gave decision hints on those 8 files — a keeps them without hints, as a notes line; b maps them again.

Not blocking: #1064 merges either way.
home: banchi docs/debts notes; claude-settings skill plain-english-map

options.gain: No shared-tool change for binary files.
options.how: The lane writes one notes line in banchi's debt store.
options.label: Accept the loss, kept as a notes line
options.lose: An edit to an icon or the model shows no decision hint.

options.how: A lane adds the 8 files' extensions to the map and writes their map lines.
options.label: Map them anyway by adding their extensions
options.lose: Map lines for binary files, and a map-check run that reads them. If it needs a shared-tool change: Goes against your ruling: a repo changes to fit a shared tool, never the tool to fit a repo.

short: banchi: decision hints on 8 binary files
title: banchi: accept losing decision hints on 8 non-code files?
why: Recommended: a. The 19 hints sit on files that rarely change, and b may bend the shared map to fit one repo.
